purpose: Preserve public fee schedule statements as scoped evidence without promoting them to instrument-specific verified execution costs.

sources.scope: Public pricing page; country/exchange selector did not expose a usable Spain-specific stock fee result during this review.
Public help article describing fee categories and conditional applicability.
Hypothetical cost endpoint; open action supported; close and buyToCover unsupported according to reference reviewed.

stocks.published_statement: A USD 1 or USD 2 commission may apply per opening and closing transaction depending on residence and exchange.
stocks.notes: Do not select USD 1 or USD 2 without a usable Spain/residence and exchange-specific determination.

etfs.published_statement: Published trading commission listed as zero; market spread remains applicable.
etfs.notes: Zero commission does not mean zero execution cost. Spread treatment and historical execution basis remain unverified.

manual_crypto.published_statement: Published commission is tiered by eToro Club level and monthly volume; Bronze/Silver/Gold show 1%, with lower tiers at higher Club levels.
manual_crypto.notes: Do not assume the user's Club tier or monthly volume. This evidence is not a round-trip cost model.

limitations: Public schedule statements do not establish the fee applicable to every configured instrument or this account.
Current bid/ask snapshots do not establish historical spread or execution prices.
An open-only hypothetical quote cannot establish closing costs.
No real portfolio, balance, holdings, positions, PnL, orders, or trade history was accessed.
approval: NOT_APPROVED; public fee schedule evidence only.
